title: introduce-credential-seed-and-lightweight-stream-compat-shim
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Adds credential seeding helpers and a lightweight stream-compat shim for Go SDK; ergonomic retry presets; prepares for v0.7.0 release. Non-breaking API additions; backwards-compatible defaults.
description:
Context and motivation: Customers integrating long-lived streaming workflows reported two recurring issues: (1) first-request auth latency spikes when SDK fetches fresh delegated credentials on warmup, and (2) minor API surface mismatches between Go/TS/Py stream iterables caused duplicated reconnection logic in client apps. This PR introduces a credential seeding helper and a compact stream-compat shim in the Go SDK, plus coordinated documentation and minor version bumps to align ergonomics across languages.

Goals: reduce warmup auth latency for bursty workloads, provide a small compatibility layer so apps sharing cross-language examples can reuse the same reconnection patterns, and add a few retry/telemetry presets that match runtime routing expectations.

What changed (high level):
- credential/seed: new package that exposes SeedCredentials(ctx, opts) to pre-populate local credential cache from existing tokens or a delegated refresh endpoint; supports TTL hints and optional backoff jitter.
- stream/compat: lightweight adaptor that normalizes Go channel/pullstream usage to the same handshake/heartbeat expectations we align in TS/Py (handshake timeout, heartbeat ping, resume token header).
- retry/presets: added "latency-sensitive" and "throughput-friendly" retry profiles wired into default client options; documented tradeoffs.
- docs/examples: cross-language snippet added to docs showing warmup + stream adapter usage for all three SDKs.
- versioning: prepares go.mod and changelog for v0.7.0 patch release; updated compat notes.

Checklist: 
- [x] Credential seeding implementation (Go)
- [x] Stream compat shim and tests
- [x] Cross-language example and docs changes (docs/compat-warmup.md)
- [x] Retry preset definitions and unit tests
- [x] Linting and CI green after fixes
- [x] Version bump and changelog entry

Commits summary: (high-level)
- Add seed credentials package and basic unit tests
- Implement stream compat adaptor and handshake tests
- Wire retry presets into client factory and add docs references
- Polish examples and update changelog for v0.7.0
- Address review feedback: tighten handshake timeout, add metrics tags, fix race in credential cache

Changed files (high level):
- sdk/go/credential/seed.go
- sdk/go/credential/seed_test.go
- sdk/go/stream/compat.go
- sdk/go/stream/compat_test.go
- sdk/go/client/options.go (wire presets)
- sdk/go/client/options_test.go
- docs/compat-warmup.md
- docs/examples/warmup-go.md
- go.mod, go.sum, CHANGELOG.md
- internal/telemetry/metrics_tags.go

Small code snippets included for reviewers: 
- compat.go handshake excerpt: "// wait for handshake (500ms), send ping, attach resume-token header"
- seed.go TTL hint parsing example: "ttlHint := opts.TTLHint; if ttlHint <= 0 { ttlHint = defaultTTL }"

Review thread (high level):
- Luca Romano: flagged potential race on credential cache update during concurrent SeedCredentials calls; asked for consolidated mutex and suggested metrics tag for "seed_path".
- Maia (author): replied with proposed fix, added a single mutex around cache writes and a unit test for concurrent seeding.
- Anne-Marie Chen: asked that the handshake timeout default be configurable and requested an integration test that simulates server-side delayed ACK.
- Maia: added config option ClientOptions.StreamHandshakeTimeout and added an integration test using the local test harness to simulate delayed ACKs.
- Devon Ortiz: requested we avoid large allocations in compat adaptor; proposed stream buffer cap and backpressure hint; author implemented a small ring buffer and added comments.
- Final approvals: Luca (approve), Anne-Marie (approve), Devon (approve) after fixes.

CI summary: 
- Initial CI run (linux/go - unit tests): failed due to linting (gofmt) and a race detected in seed_test (concurrent map write).
- Follow-up commits fixed formatting and added cache mutex; race detector run passed.
- Integration tests (local harness) reported one flaky test; increased handshake timeout in test and added jitter tolerance.
- Final CI: all checks passed (unit, integration, lint, vet, race).

Performance/telemetry notes: 
- Measured median first-request auth latency drop from ~120ms to ~35ms in our dev benchmark when seed is used (warm cache scenario).
- Added two new metrics: sdk.seed.success and sdk.stream.handshake_latency_ms tagged by preset.

Backward compatibility: No breaking changes; default behavior unchanged unless users opt into SeedCredentials() or the new stream compat adaptor. The new retry presets are additive; default retry profile remains unchanged.

Merge outcome: Squash-merged into main on 2026-02-22. Squash commit message: "feat(auth/stream): add credential seeding and stream compat shim; retry presets; prepare v0.7.0"
